# daemon

> Cross-platform daemon lifecycle library for Go applications. Pure Go, zero CGO, zero dependencies (stdlib only).

Module: github.com/grpmsoft/daemon
Go: 1.27+
License: MIT
Organization: grpmsoft (github.com/grpmsoft)

## Overview

daemon manages background daemon processes with HTTP health checks, PID file locking, signal handling, connection tracking, and idle auto-shutdown. Built for tools that need a persistent background server — MCP servers, language servers, dev tools.

Three modes: Client mode (Start/Stop/Restart/EnsureRunning/Status — manage a background daemon), Server mode (Serve — run as the foreground daemon with HTTP, PID, signals), and Proxy mode (Proxy — bridge stdin/stdout to daemon HTTP for MCP/JSON-RPC).

## API

### Core Types

- `Daemon` — lifecycle manager. Created via New(Config) or NewWithDeps(Config, PIDStore, ProcessManager, HealthChecker) for testing.
- `Config` — Name (string), DataDir (string), Binary (string, default os.Executable()), Args ([]string), Timeout (time.Duration, default 30s), HealthPath (string, default "/health"), IdleTimeout (time.Duration, 0=disabled).
- `Status` — enum: StatusStopped, StatusStarting, StatusRunning, StatusStopping, StatusError.
- `Info` — status snapshot: Status, PID, Port, Name, StartTime, Uptime.
- `Group` — concurrent actor orchestration (oklog/run reimplemented, zero deps). Add(execute, interrupt) pairs; Run() starts all; first return triggers interrupt on all others.
- `ConnTracker` — atomic connection counter with idle notification channels.

### Interfaces (for testability)

- `PIDStore` — Save, Load, Clear, IsAlive, Path. Abstracts PID file persistence.
- `ProcessManager` — StartDetached, KillProcess(ctx, pid, grace), IsProcessAlive. Platform-specific process management.
- `HealthChecker` — Check, WaitUntilReady. HTTP health polling (fixed 500ms interval).

### Functions

- `New(Config) *Daemon` — create with default implementations.
- `NewWithDeps(Config, PIDStore, ProcessManager, HealthChecker) *Daemon` — create with mocks for testing.
- `Serve(ctx, Config, http.Handler) error` — run as daemon: picks free port, writes PID file, registers /health + /daemon/connect + /daemon/disconnect, blocks until signal/context/idle.
- `EnsureRunning(ctx, Config) (port int, err error)` — package-level convenience. Creates Daemon internally, returns port. Race-safe PID locking.
- `Proxy(ctx, cfg Config, opts ProxyOptions) error` — bridge io.Reader/Writer to daemon HTTP endpoint. Checks IsHeld before dialing (returns ErrNotRunning for dead daemons). Testable, no hardcoded timeout.

### Daemon Methods

- `Start(ctx) (*Info, error)` — spawn detached background process (Binary/Args from Config), wait for health check. Returns error if already running.
- `EnsureRunning(ctx) (*Info, error)` — idempotent start-if-needed. Returns existing *Info if daemon is running.
- `Stop(ctx) error` — graceful stop serialized on startup lock: HTTP /daemon/shutdown → wait → fallback to kill. Idempotent (returns nil if not running).
- `Restart(ctx) (*Info, error)` — stop + start under one lock acquisition.
- `Status() (*Info, error)` — read-only, no lock. Reads PID file, checks process liveness, returns status snapshot.
- `IsRunning() bool` — read-only, no lock. Quick check via PID file.

All mutating methods serialize on the startup lock. Read-only methods (Status, IsRunning) do not acquire the lock.

## Usage Patterns

### Client Mode
```go
cfg := daemon.Config{Name: "myapp", DataDir: ".myapp", Args: []string{"serve"}}
d := daemon.New(cfg)
info, err := d.Start(ctx)   // spawns detached process, waits for health, returns *Info
info, _ = d.Status()         // reads PID file, checks process (no lock)
d.Stop(ctx)                  // graceful shutdown (serialized on lock)
```

### Server Mode
```go
daemon.Serve(ctx, daemon.Config{
    Name:        "myapp",
    DataDir:     ".myapp",
    IdleTimeout: 5 * time.Minute,
}, httpHandler) // blocks until shutdown
```

### Proxy Mode (MCP/JSON-RPC bridge)
```go
port, _ := daemon.EnsureRunning(ctx, cfg) // Binary and Args are in cfg
daemon.Proxy(ctx, cfg, daemon.ProxyOptions{MCPPath: "/mcp"}) // stdin/stdout ↔ HTTP
```

## File Structure

```
daemon.go        — Daemon struct, Start/Stop/Restart/EnsureRunning/Status/Serve, ConnTracker
                   Internal: acquireStartupLock, startLocked, stopLocked, buildInfo
config.go        — Config (with Binary, Args), Status enum, Info, interfaces (PIDStore, ProcessManager, HealthChecker)
group.go         — Group: concurrent actor orchestration
proxy.go         — Proxy: stdin/stdout to HTTP bridge + IsHeld pre-check
ensure.go        — EnsureRunning (package-level wrapper): start-if-needed with race handling
defaults.go      — Default interface implementations
internal/
  pidlock/       — Cross-platform lock primitive (TryLock, Release, WriteData, ReadLocked, IsHeld, InheritFD)
  process.go     — Cross-platform process utilities (IsProcessAlive, KillProcess(ctx, pid, grace))
  process_unix.go    — Unix: StartDetached via os.StartProcess with Setsid
  process_windows.go — Windows: StartDetached via CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP
  health.go      — HTTP health check polling (fixed 500ms interval)
```
